name: prowess-studio
description: Prowess Platform monorepo — Studio application and shared domain packages.

scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:architecture && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @prowess/db exec prisma generate
scripts.db:validate: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @prowess/db exec prisma validate
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @prowess/db exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @prowess/db exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:status: node scripts/with-env.mjs pnpm --filter @prowess/db exec prisma migrate status
